notes:
- Discord sign-in no longer stops on an invalid URL: The authorize request sent Discord a redirect of anisequel://discord, an arbitrary custom scheme that Discord's developer portal will not register for a standard OAuth2 application - so the page stopped on Discord's invalid redirect URL instead of the login form, and no callback ever reached the phone. The sign-in now uses the mobile redirect Discord documents, discord-1571747436542566561:/authorize/callback, which the intent filter handles and the token exchange sends back byte for byte. The old anisequel://discord filter stays registered so a flow already in flight on an older build still lands here.
- The application ID field prints the redirect to register: The field now shows the exact redirect URI the sign-in uses, discord-1571747436542566561:/authorize/callback, so a reader who supplies their own Discord application registers the address that works instead of the one that produced the invalid-URL page.
